_comment: Editorial content for ITTEFAQ. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: no licence-cleared photograph of this company's own facility exists on the open licence sources, and a generic industry photo would imply it is theirs.
description: Ittefaq Iron Industries Limited, part of the Al-Shafi group, was incorporated in 2007 and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange in July 2017. It operates a steel rolling mill manufacturing iron bars, girders and related products, with its head office at Gulberg III, Lahore.
sourceNote: Company website (ittefaqsteel.com: profile, contact) and the PSX company profile (dps.psx.com.pk/company/ITTEFAQ: business description, key people, address), read 2026-10-17.
